_comment: cargo-geiger baseline (T1174): total unsafe items/expressions summed over workspace crates (used + unused). CI fails when the total grows; lower it when unsafe is removed. NOTE: cargo-geiger folds dependency unsafe into the binary package's entry, so the tool's total is clj-rt 110 + clj-aot 11 + clojure-rs rollup 121 = 242 (R1 finding 2); own-counts are unchanged. T1192 D-argv adds the clj-rt +21 (rt_argv shim + its FFI-boundary tests; the rollup folds the same +21). T73 item 8 adds +24 (rt_keyword shim + its FFI-boundary tests: clj-rt +12, rollup +12). Gap-124 slice 1 adds +10 (tools_deps_config env-mutating tests: set_var/remove_var are unsafe in edition 2024). Gap-121 slice 1 adds +10 measured (jit.rs EE surface: the unsafe C entry type plus the entry-lookup-and-call block; clj-aot 11->16, rollup folds the same +5. Both constructs are inherent to in-process MCJIT — the entry must be named as an unsafe C fn type and called — so the ratchet moves with justification rather than the code shrinking. Supersedes the +2 estimate, which undercounted the measured clj-aot growth). Gap-124 slice 3 adds +6 measured (tools_deps_api serial hermetic test: env save/restore + guard around CLJ_CONFIG, same shape as the baselined slice-1 helpers — serial, guard-restored, SAFETY-commented. In-process env control has no safe spelling in edition 2024 and the hermeticity is load-bearing, so the ratchet moves with justification like slice 1 rather than the test weakening). G1 routes 2 inline env sites via set_env/unset_env helpers (count-neutral) and fixes rt_argv null-entry UB (null->nil) with a regression test (measured +8: safe null branch in the unsafe rt_argv fn counts +4 on clj-rt 110->114, rollup folds the same 4, 134->138; the honest price of a real UB fix, removed wholesale when Z3 deletes the pointer shims).
